credits.title: Anecdotes of Ape Mountain
credits.overview: When the legendary Ape God is rumored to have turned against the Ape Kingdom, master Yan Yidao sends his disciple Xuan Cheng to investigate the truth and calm the frightened people.

credits.title: Big Deal
credits.overview: A community police officer is assigned as first party secretary to push an old-neighborhood renewal. He wins residents’ trust but collapses from overwork; his family honors his wish to donate organs, turning “small” neighborly issues into a truly big deal.

credits.title: 潮起东方中国龙-2024山东春晚
New Home
credits.overview: Deputy Mayor Zhao Weiguo is the first secretary stationed in their village. Despite their illness, they do work of mobilizing poverty alleviation and relocation. As many poor households are concerned to if relocating is good for them, Zhao Weiguo needs to ease their minds with practical action.

credits.title: Super Four
credits.overview: A modest family of 4 goes on a spending extravaganza after finding a bag of 3 million dollars while the criminals to whom it belongs track them down to get it back.
